fields.note: Listings loaded via JavaScript - Playwright/Selenium required

notes: This is an Elementor WordPress site that loads business listings dynamically via JavaScript. The static HTML only contains blog posts about buying/selling businesses, not the actual business-for-sale listings. JavaScript rendering (Playwright/Selenium) is required to scrape the actual listings. The site is located in Colorado and serves Boulder, Denver, Fort Collins, Breckenridge, Parker, and Evergreen areas.
